::: {#def-roster-notation}
#### Roster notation

Writing a set (@def-set) by listing its elements between braces,
as in $\set{1, 2, 3}$,
is called **roster notation**
[@wikipedia_set_mathematics].
An ellipsis, "$\ldots$", can stand for elements that follow a clear pattern,
as in $\set{10, 20, 30, \ldots, 90}$.

:::
